sehemu: Part II: Members of Parliament, Constituencies and Election of Members
jina: Procedure for election of Members elected by the House of Representatives
maudhui: The House of Representatives shall prescribe the procedure it shall follow for the election of the Members of Parliament referred to in Article 66(1)(c) of this Constitution.
